answer: An AI-agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by tying each identity via a cross-chain bridge to verifiable storage on lotus nodes. Each agent seals a unique sector via sequential graph labeling and answers random Merkle challenges before tight deadlines. Because sealed sectors resist compression and fast recomputation, an attacker must commit real disk space and compute per identity. However, operators in a cheap power haven can still rent bulk drives to back multiple identities.
